Initial release: Social media pre-flight checker for Reddit, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and HackerNews

- Scans draft posts against 30+ documented, research-backed platform-specific rules
- Reports PASS/WARN/FAIL per rule with exact fix suggestions and severity level
- Covers key invisible algorithm and moderation rules per platform (e.g., self-promo ratios, link penalties, AI content flags)
- Supports easy CLI usage; outputs both text and JSON for integration
- Pure Python, zero external dependencies; provides exit codes for automation
